name: SparkFun Thing Plus - RP2040
description: Feather-footprint RP2040 with 16 MB flash, microSD slot, 500 mA LiPo charger with fuel gauge, Qwiic, USB-C and WS2812: a ready-made data logger platform.
notes: Feather-compatible header geometry but 58.4 mm long (extra space for the microSD socket); header pin 16 is the WS2812 data-out, positions 9-10 are unconnected.
microSD is SPI-mode on dedicated GPIO; MAX17048 fuel gauge on I2C; 2x5 1.27 mm JTAG/SWD pads.
Header labels derived from SparkFun's Eagle files; SCL/SDA are GP7/GP6 (I2C1, shared with the Qwiic connector).
